Figure 6: mean vertical gradients of potential temperature (θ), specific humidity (q) and wind speed (U) between the coastal reference station (48 m) and each station of the transect, for fog, dew and no AW occurrence (classification anchored at OYA1211), with ±1 standard deviation. Figure 5: vertical profiles of θ, q and U on a typical fog day (28 April 2024) and a typical dew day (24 April 2024). The last chunk prints the mean ± 1 standard deviation of ∂θ/∂z and ∂q/∂z at OYA1211 used in Table 2. OYA1069 is omitted (no valid temperature or wind data in 2024).

Inputs: `data/derived/stations_10min_2024.csv` (step 2) and `data/derived/oya1211_classification_2024.csv` (step 3). Outputs: `figures/fig05_profiles_typical_days.png` and `figures/fig06_vertical_gradients.png`.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

dir_data <- "../data"
dir_fig  <- "../figures"
```

```{r}
#| label: data-gradients

dat <- read_csv(file.path(dir_data, "derived/stations_10min_2024.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(datetime, tz = "UTC"))

clasif <- read_csv(file.path(dir_data, "derived/oya1211_classification_2024.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(datetime = as.POSIXct(datetime, tz = "UTC"), clasif_evento)

dat <- dat %>% left_join(clasif, by = "datetime")

R  <- 287        # J kg-1 K-1
Cp <- 1004.67    # J kg-1 K-1
g  <- 9.80665    # m s-2

alturas <- tribble(
  ~estacion,    ~z_m,
  "AEROPUERTO",   48,
  "OYA_518",     518,
  "OYA_780",     780,
  "OYA_862",     862,
  "OYA_1069",   1069,
  "OYA_1128",   1128,
  "OYA_1193",   1193,
  "OYA_1211",   1211,
  "OYA_1354",   1354
)

dat <- dat %>%
  left_join(alturas, by = "estacion") %>%
  filter(estacion != "GOES")

aeropuerto_ref <- dat %>%
  filter(estacion == "AEROPUERTO") %>%
  select(datetime, P1 = presion, T1_C = temperatura)

# Pressure: measured where available; otherwise hypsometric from the airport
# (as in code/04_thermodynamic_variables.qmd). θ referred to the airport pressure.
# q with the Magnus formula (6.112 exp(17.67 T / (T + 243.5))).
dat <- dat %>%
  left_join(aeropuerto_ref, by = "datetime") %>%
  mutate(
    T_K   = temperatura + 273.15,
    T1_K  = T1_C + 273.15,
    Tm_K  = (T_K + T1_K) / 2,
    presion_calc  = P1 * exp(-(g * (z_m - 48)) / (R * Tm_K)),
    presion_final = if_else(is.na(presion) & !is.na(P1), presion_calc, presion),
    theta_K = T_K * (P1 / presion_final)^(R / Cp),
    es_hPa  = 6.112 * exp((17.67 * temperatura) / (temperatura + 243.5)),
    e_hPa   = humedad / 100 * es_hPa,
    q_gkg   = 1000 * 0.622 * e_hPa / (presion_final - (1 - 0.622) * e_hPa)
  )

# Gradients relative to the coastal reference (airport, 48 m), every 10 min
grad <- dat %>%
  group_by(datetime) %>%
  mutate(
    theta_ref = theta_K[estacion == "AEROPUERTO"][1],
    q_ref     = q_gkg[estacion == "AEROPUERTO"][1],
    u_ref     = viento_vel_m_s[estacion == "AEROPUERTO"][1]
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    grad_theta = (theta_K - theta_ref) / (z_m - 48),
    grad_q     = (q_gkg - q_ref) / (z_m - 48),
    grad_u     = (viento_vel_m_s - u_ref) / (z_m - 48)
  ) %>%
  filter(z_m != 48, estacion != "OYA_1069",
         clasif_evento %in% c("NIEBLA", "ROCIO", "SIN_EVENTO"))

resumen <- grad %>%
  pivot_longer(c(grad_q, grad_theta, grad_u), names_to = "variable", values_to = "valor") %>%
  group_by(variable, clasif_evento, z_m) %>%
  summarise(media = mean(valor, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(valor, na.rm = TRUE),
            mediana = median(valor, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(valor)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  # reference point at 48 m: gradient 0 by definition (no standard deviation)
  bind_rows(expand_grid(variable = c("grad_q", "grad_theta", "grad_u"),
                        clasif_evento = c("NIEBLA", "ROCIO", "SIN_EVENTO"),
                        z_m = 48, media = 0, sd = NA_real_, mediana = 0, n = NA_integer_)) %>%
  mutate(
    regimen = factor(recode(clasif_evento, "NIEBLA" = "Fog", "ROCIO" = "Dew",
                            "SIN_EVENTO" = "No AW"),
                     levels = c("Fog", "Dew", "No AW")),
    estacion_lab = factor(paste0(z_m, " m"), levels = paste0(sort(unique(z_m)), " m")),
    y = as.numeric(estacion_lab) + case_when(regimen == "Fog" ~ 0.2,
                                             regimen == "Dew" ~ 0,
                                             TRUE ~ -0.2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable, regimen, z_m)   # order by altitude so that geom_path joins the points correctly
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-gradients

col_reg <- c("Fog" = "#4292c6", "Dew" = "#c97a4a", "No AW" = "#7f7f7f")
niveles_y <- levels(resumen$estacion_lab)
y_1211 <- which(niveles_y == "1211 m")

tema_grad <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.title    = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.line       = element_line(color = "#c3c2b7"),
    axis.ticks      = element_line(color = "#c3c2b7"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#ecebe6", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10)
  )

# reference thresholds (in units of 10^-3)
# means of this study at OYA1211 (units of 10^-3), computed from the data
media_1211 <- function(var, regs) {
  1000 * mean(grad[[var]][grad$z_m == 1211 & grad$clasif_evento %in% regs], na.rm = TRUE)
}
m_fog <- media_1211("grad_theta", "NIEBLA")
m_dew <- media_1211("grad_theta", "ROCIO")
m_q   <- mean(c(media_1211("grad_q", "NIEBLA"), media_1211("grad_q", "ROCIO")))

umbrales <- tribble(
  ~variable,    ~x,    ~color,    ~etiqueta,                ~nivel,
  "grad_theta", m_fog, "#4292c6", sprintf("%.2f", m_fog),   1,
  "grad_theta", 3.1,   "#8b1a1a", "3.1",                    2,
  "grad_theta", m_dew, "#c97a4a", sprintf("%.2f", m_dew),   3,
  "grad_q",     -1.6,  "#8b1a1a", "-1.6",                   1
)
print(umbrales)
# Lobos Roco et al. (2018): dark red; this study: blue (fog), orange (dew)

panel_grad <- function(var, titulo, xlab, xlim = NULL) {
  d <- resumen %>% filter(variable == var)
  u <- umbrales %>% filter(variable == var)
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(y = y, color = regimen)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = y_1211 - 0.45, ymax = y_1211 + 0.45,
             fill = "#f3f1ea", color = NA) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#c3c2b7", linewidth = 0.4)
  if (nrow(u) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(data = u, aes(xintercept = x), color = u$color,
                 linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.45, inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  p <- p +
    geom_segment(aes(x = (media - sd) * 1000, xend = (media + sd) * 1000, yend = y),
                 linewidth = 1.1, alpha = 0.2, lineend = "round") +
    geom_path(aes(x = media * 1000, group = regimen), linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(x = media * 1000), size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = col_reg) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(niveles_y), labels = niveles_y,
                       expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = c(0.6, length(niveles_y) + 1.75), clip = "off") +
    labs(title = titulo, x = xlab, y = NULL) +
    tema_grad
  if (nrow(u) > 0) {
    p <- p + geom_label(data = u, aes(x = x, y = length(niveles_y) + 0.35 + 0.42 * nivel, label = etiqueta),
                        color = u$color, fill = "white", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.08, "lines"),
                        size = 2.6, fontface = "bold", inherit.aes = FALSE)
  }
  p
}

pq  <- panel_grad("grad_q",     "(B) Specific humidity",  expression(partialdiff*q/partialdiff*z~(10^{-3}~g~kg^{-1}~m^{-1})))
# ∂θ/∂z: X axis limited to widen the separation between fog and dew; the
# standard deviations of no AW occurrence (up to ~14 x 10^-3) are cut,
# but all the means remain visible.
pth <- panel_grad("grad_theta", "(A) Potential temperature", expression(partialdiff*theta/partialdiff*z~(10^{-3}~K~m^{-1})),
                  xlim = c(-0.2, 9.95)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 8, 2), expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
  labs(y = "Station altitude (m a.s.l.)")
pu  <- panel_grad("grad_u",     "(C) Wind speed",         expression(partialdiff*U/partialdiff*z~(10^{-3}~s^{-1})))

# the three panels with the same width
fig_gradientes <- (pth | pq | pu) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 1, 1)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

fig_gradientes

ggsave(file.path(dir_fig, "fig06_vertical_gradients.png"),
       fig_gradientes, width = 12, height = 5.4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
  arrange(variable, regimen, z_m) %>% print(n = Inf)
```

# Figure 5: vertical profiles on typical days (28 April fog, 24 April dew)

Hour selection (hourly records, minute 00): for fog and dew, the hour with the most contrasting θ between both regimes (the fog hour with the smallest increase of θ between 48 and 1211 m and the dew hour with the largest increase); for no AW occurrence, the full hour without water collection at OYA1211 with the largest increase of θ. Stations are evenly spaced and OYA1211 is highlighted with a band, as in Figure 6. OYA1069 is omitted (no valid data).

```{r}
#| label: fig-profiles-days
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6.5

dias_sel <- tribble(
  ~fecha,            ~etiqueta,
  # ordinals as superscripts (plotmath expressions, read with label_parsed)
  ymd("2024-04-28"), 'bold("April 28"^"th"*", 2024 (fog)")',
  ymd("2024-04-24"), 'bold("April 24"^"th"*", 2024 (dew)")'
)

dat_horas <- dat %>%
  filter(minute(datetime) == 0, estacion != "OYA_1069") %>%
  mutate(fecha = as.Date(datetime), hora = hour(datetime))

# Hours with no AW occurrence: first and last of the day at OYA1211
horas_sin <- dat_horas %>%
  filter(fecha %in% dias_sel$fecha, estacion == "OYA_1211", clasif_evento == "SIN_EVENTO") %>%
  group_by(fecha, clasif_evento) %>%
  summarise(primera = min(hora), ultima = max(hora), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(primera, ultima), names_to = "momento", values_to = "hora")

# Fog and dew hours: the hour with the most contrasting θ between both regimes,
# that is, the fog hour with the smallest increase of θ between 48 and 1211 m (most
# homogeneous profile) and the dew hour with the largest increase (most stratified profile).
dtheta_hora <- dat_horas %>%
  filter(fecha %in% dias_sel$fecha) %>%
  group_by(fecha, hora) %>%
  summarise(dtheta = theta_K[z_m == 1211][1] - theta_K[z_m == 48][1], .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(dat_horas %>% filter(estacion == "OYA_1211") %>% select(fecha, hora, clasif_evento),
            by = c("fecha", "hora"))
print(dtheta_hora %>% filter(clasif_evento %in% c("NIEBLA", "ROCIO")))

horas_occ <- bind_rows(
  dtheta_hora %>% filter(clasif_evento == "NIEBLA") %>% slice_min(dtheta, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE),
  dtheta_hora %>% filter(clasif_evento == "ROCIO")  %>% slice_max(dtheta, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
) %>%
  transmute(fecha, clasif_evento, momento = "ocurrencia", hora)

horas_sel <- bind_rows(horas_occ, horas_sin)
# plotted hours: fog, dew and, for each day, the hour with no AW occurrence
# most contrasting in θ with the occurrence, that is, the one with the largest increase of θ between
# 48 and 1211 m among the full hours without water collection at OYA1211 (the six
# 10-min records of the hour with no AW occurrence)
horas_sin_completas <- dat %>%
  filter(estacion == "OYA_1211", as.Date(datetime) %in% dias_sel$fecha) %>%
  mutate(fecha = as.Date(datetime), hora = hour(datetime)) %>%
  group_by(fecha, hora) %>%
  summarise(sin_captacion = all(clasif_evento == "SIN_EVENTO"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(sin_captacion)

horas_sin_contraste <- dtheta_hora %>%
  filter(clasif_evento == "SIN_EVENTO") %>%
  semi_join(horas_sin_completas, by = c("fecha", "hora")) %>%
  group_by(fecha) %>%
  slice_max(dtheta, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(fecha, clasif_evento, momento = "contraste", hora)
print(horas_sin_contraste)

horas_fig <- bind_rows(horas_occ, horas_sin_contraste)

perf <- dat_horas %>%
  inner_join(horas_fig, by = c("fecha", "hora", "clasif_evento")) %>%
  inner_join(dias_sel, by = "fecha") %>%
  mutate(
    etiqueta = factor(etiqueta, levels = dias_sel$etiqueta),
    serie_leg = case_when(
      clasif_evento == "NIEBLA" ~ "Fog",
      clasif_evento == "ROCIO"  ~ "Dew",
      momento == "contraste"    ~ "No AW",
      TRUE                      ~ "No AW, last hour"
    ),
    serie_leg = factor(serie_leg, levels = c("Fog", "Dew", "No AW",
                                             "No AW, last hour")),
    serie    = paste(serie_leg, hora),
    estacion_lab = factor(paste0(z_m, " m"), levels = paste0(sort(unique(z_m)), " m")),
    y = as.numeric(estacion_lab)
  ) %>%
  select(etiqueta, serie_leg, hora, serie, z_m, estacion_lab, y,
         theta_K, q_gkg, viento_vel_m_s) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(theta_K, q_gkg, viento_vel_m_s), names_to = "variable", values_to = "valor") %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("theta_K", "q_gkg", "viento_vel_m_s"),
                           labels = c("theta~(K)",
                                      "q~(g~kg^{-1})",
                                      "U~(m~s^{-1})"))) %>%
  arrange(etiqueta, serie, variable, z_m)

# hours shown (for the caption)
print(horas_sel %>% arrange(fecha, clasif_evento, hora))

niveles_y_d <- levels(perf$estacion_lab)
y_1211_d <- which(niveles_y_d == "1211 m")

fig_perfiles_dias <- ggplot(perf, aes(x = valor, y = y, color = serie_leg,
                                      linetype = serie_leg, shape = serie_leg, group = serie)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = y_1211_d - 0.45, ymax = y_1211_d + 0.45,
           fill = "#f3f1ea", color = NA) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 1.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(etiqueta ~ variable, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(variable = label_parsed, etiqueta = label_parsed)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Fog" = "#4292c6", "Dew" = "#c97a4a",
                                "No AW" = "#7f7f7f",
                                "No AW, last hour" = "#7f7f7f"), drop = TRUE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Fog" = "solid", "Dew" = "solid",
                                   "No AW" = "solid",
                                   "No AW, last hour" = "22"), drop = TRUE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Fog" = 16, "Dew" = 16,
                                "No AW" = 16,
                                "No AW, last hour" = 1), drop = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(niveles_y_d), labels = niveles_y_d,
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Station altitude (m a.s.l.)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    axis.line        = element_line(color = "#c3c2b7"),
    axis.ticks       = element_line(color = "#c3c2b7"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#ecebe6", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "#c3c2b7", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#f9f9f7", color = NA),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y     = element_text(angle = -90),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

fig_perfiles_dias

ggsave(file.path(dir_fig, "fig05_profiles_typical_days.png"),
       fig_perfiles_dias, width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
#| label: values-profiles
# Profile values used in the text of Section 3.2
perfiles_txt <- dat_horas %>%
  inner_join(horas_sel, by = c("fecha", "hora", "clasif_evento")) %>%
  select(fecha, clasif_evento, momento, hora, z_m, theta_K, q_gkg, viento_vel_m_s) %>%
  arrange(fecha, clasif_evento, hora, z_m)
print(perfiles_txt, n = Inf, width = Inf)
perfiles_txt %>% group_by(fecha, clasif_evento, hora) %>%
  summarise(dtheta_48_1211 = theta_K[z_m == 1211] - theta_K[z_m == 48],
            dtheta_1211_1354 = theta_K[z_m == 1354] - theta_K[z_m == 1211],
            q_min_48_1211 = min(q_gkg[z_m <= 1211], na.rm = TRUE),
            q_max_48_1211 = max(q_gkg[z_m <= 1211], na.rm = TRUE),
            q_1354 = q_gkg[z_m == 1354], .groups = "drop") %>% print(width = Inf)
```

```{r}
  group_by(fecha, clasif_evento, hora) %>%
  summarise(dtheta_48_1211 = theta_K[z_m == 1211] - theta_K[z_m == 48],
            dtheta_1211_1354 = theta_K[z_m == 1354] - theta_K[z_m == 1211],
            q_min_48_1211 = min(q_gkg[z_m <= 1211], na.rm = TRUE),
            q_max_48_1211 = max(q_gkg[z_m <= 1211], na.rm = TRUE),
            q_1354 = q_gkg[z_m == 1354], .groups = "drop") %>% print(width = Inf)
```


```{r}
#| label: table-2-mean-sd
# Table 2 of the manuscript. Mean ± 1 standard deviation of ∂θ/∂z (K m-1) and
# ∂q/∂z (g kg-1 m-1) between the coastal station (48 m) and OYA1211, by regime, 2024.
# Columns in units of 10^-3: mean, lower bound (mean - SD) and upper bound (mean + SD).
grad %>%
  filter(z_m == 1211) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(grad_theta, grad_q), names_to = "variable", values_to = "valor") %>%
  group_by(variable, clasif_evento) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(valor)),
            media = 1000 * mean(valor, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd    = 1000 * sd(valor, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(bajo = media - sd, alto = media + sd) %>%
  arrange(variable, clasif_evento) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```
